resource_load.note: Git operations: resolve ref, get notes commit, traverse tree, read blob, get last commit

performance_issues.description: Git note lookup involves multiple git operations (resolve ref, tree traversal, blob read) with no caching
performance_issues.impact: Each request performs multiple git filesystem operations
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider caching notes ref commit for frequently accessed repos

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache the notes ref commit resolution to avoid repeated git operations
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce git operations by 50% for repeated note lookups
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use LastCommitCache or similar mechanism for notes ref

resource_load.note: 4 DB queries: get comment, load issue, find reactions, load users

performance_issues.description: FindCommentReactions has no pagination - returns all reactions for a comment
performance_issues.impact: Comments with many reactions will return unbounded result sets
performance_issues.recommendation: Add pagination support to comment reactions endpoint

optimization_recommendations.description: Add page/limit query params to comment reactions endpoint
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevent large response payloads for popular comments
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Pass ListOptions to FindCommentReactions like FindIssueReactions does
